title: [Extensibility Request] issue 29078: Add OnBeforeTestTransferLine event
summary: An OnBeforeTestTransferLine integration event was added to the TestTransferLine procedure on the Transfer Header table, enabling extensions to observe or extend transfer line testing logic.
key_points: New OnBeforeTestTransferLine event fires at the start of TestTransferLine procedure
Allows add-on developers to hook into transfer line validation logic
Event added to W1 and all regional layers (RU, NA, IT)
Follows standard naming convention for before-events
Enables custom scenarios for transfer line item tracking checks
